srs: The warehouse stock system records Operator, StockEntry, InventoryService, and Bin; each has an id attribute. Each Operator can have zero or more StockEntry records, and each StockEntry belongs to exactly one Operator. Each StockEntry uses exactly one InventoryService, and each InventoryService serves zero or more StockEntry records. Each InventoryService manages one or more Bin records by composition, and each Bin belongs to exactly one InventoryService. Each Operator can reference zero or more Bin records, and each Bin can be referenced by zero or more Operator records.
